text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in opening and repeated position throughout","quality":"stance clarity","description":"The essay states its position early and keeps that argument consistent from beginning to end."},{"evidence":"quoted article details followed by explanation of pollution and safety","quality":"use of evidence","description":"The essay uses source details and explains how they support its claims rather than just mentioning them."},{"evidence":"paragraph on pollution, paragraph on flexibility, paragraph on crash record, paragraph on law","quality":"organization","description":"The essay develops its argument in a more orderly paragraph structure with one main point at a time."},{"evidence":"“This would benefit everyone…”, “This is better for an individual consumer and the global population”","quality":"reasoning development","description":"The essay more fully connects the article’s facts to broader consequences and explains why they matter."},{"evidence":"“A counter argument…is the law”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges a limitation of driverless cars and addresses it directly in the argument."},{"evidence":"“we need to let the future in because it will drive us to greatness”","quality":"conclusion effectiveness","description":"The essay ends with a more purposeful conclusion that reinforces the main claim."}]}
